★★★★★
“We had a wonderful Munnar and Marayoor trip. It rained during our visit, but the team made sure we stayed safe throughout. The villa was clean, scenic and comfortable, and the food was excellent. The jeep safari was the highlight of our trip. Everything was well organised. Highly recommended!”

A big thank you to the driver for his humility and support.”
